cohort: 764 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 and 765 uninfected pregnant women (control group)
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had higher rates of ICU admission, respiratory failure, and cesarean section (primarily due to obstetric and maternal complications) compared to uninfected pregnant women.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was higher in the COVID-19 group, with obstetric and maternal complications being the most common indications compared to fetal indications in the control group.
